scope6_deferral_record.note_on_the_delta: The both-schema count rose from 22 to 25 as a direct, expected side effect of Phase 6: the three SCOPE 7 entries gained a `path` field while retaining their existing `chunks_dir` field, moving them from the legacy-only bucket (15 -> 12) into the both-schema bucket (22 -> 25). The absolute-chunks_dir count (37) is unchanged since none of Phase 6's edits touched a chunks_dir value.
scope6_deferral_record.consumer_scan: grep -l chunks_dir .claude/scripts/literature-*.sh finds three scripts referencing the string: literature-ingest.sh (writes chunks_dir for new legacy ingests, does not read it preferentially), literature-chunk.sh (a code comment only), and literature-fidelity-audit.sh (documents the legacy schema in its header but explicitly limits its own scan to sources/<dir>/, i.e. does not act on chunks_dir preferentially over path). No consumer reads chunks_dir in preference to path.
scope6_deferral_record.conclusion: This is legacy residue from two historical ingestion pipelines (the original chunks_dir-only schema and its v2 path-based successor), not active breakage. Absolute-path normalization of the 37 chunks_dir values would be a portability nice-to-have (relevant only if LITERATURE_DIR ever moves), not a correctness fix. Deferred, not silently dropped -- recorded here per Planning Decision 3.
